# The fact-cache env the issue exported, with the connection directory
# relative to the case's scratch copy so the shipped warm entry (cache/s1_h)
# is what the run reads. TIMEOUT=0 because the shipped entry must never age
# out of the cache plugin's default 24h window.
ANSIBLE_CACHE_PLUGIN=jsonfile
ANSIBLE_CACHE_PLUGIN_CONNECTION=cache
ANSIBLE_CACHE_PLUGIN_TIMEOUT=0
ANSIBLE_GATHERING=smart
